title: Paying Off an Equipment & Vehicle Loans Loan: Payoff Quote, Payoff Date and Lien Release
content:
**Terms.** A payoff quote on an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan states, for a payoff date the member names, all assessed fees not yet paid, billed interest not yet paid, interest from the day after the last due date through the payoff date at the contract rate, any prepayment fee under the prepayment terms on the principal paid ahead of schedule, and the principal balance. A quote is good through the product's payoff quote validity in calendar days after the quote date, the quote date being day 0; a payment received later is applied as a regular payment and a new quote is needed. The loan is paid off on the effective date of the payment that brings principal, interest and fees to zero, every pledged unit is released with the release reason payoff, and the lien is released within the product's lien release period in business days. An overpayment of the payoff is refunded to the member and never held on the loan.

## What a payoff quote states

| Item | Basis |
|---|---|
| Assessed fees not yet paid | all of them |
| Billed interest not yet paid | all of it |
| Interest to the payoff date | from the day after the last due date through the payoff date, at the contract rate |
| Prepayment fee | any fee under the prepayment terms on the principal paid ahead of schedule |
| Principal | the principal balance |

## Quote validity on both sides

Hypothetical: a quote dated 3 May on a product whose quote is good for 10 calendar days.

| Payment received | Day after the quote date | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| 13 May | day 10 | within the quote |
| 14 May | day 11 | applied as a regular payment; a new quote is needed |

## On the payoff date

- The loan is paid off on the effective date of the payment that brings principal, interest and fees to zero.
- Every pledged unit is released with the release reason payoff, and the lien is released within the product's lien release period in business days.
- Any amount paid above the payoff is refunded to the member; it is never held on the loan.
